answer: The ropewalk doors are shut against the sea wind, because a draught will dry the hemp before it is laid. Cord sisal mesh knitter flax warrant rules the shutting: a warrant sisal mesh knitters show after knotting bench trials. The summit is the first door shut, the zephyr the last before the laying begins, and the jetty is the beginning, the strands drawn out taut. A cheat must shut 41 false doors and draw 41 false strands.
